title: Stasis Plug-In Spell
description: A surreal scene depicts a classical stone statue with its head replaced by an old CRT monitor displaying text, connected to a floating keyboard labeled "ONE" and a computer mouse. In the background, sailing ships navigate a stylized sea scattered with floating computer keys and interface elements under a stormy sky with lightning.
prompt: Surreal painting of a weathered classical stone statue standing in a stylized ocean, its head replaced by a bulky old CRT computer monitor with text on screen, wires connecting to a floating keyboard and a computer mouse hanging in the air. The sea is covered with floating computer keys and UI elements. Several old sailing ships are on the water. Dramatic stormy sky with lightning and dark purple clouds at sunset. Mystical and anachronistic atmosphere.
